name: A thin hiss under the exposed passages

surface.note: The vinyl bed itself, brighter and thinner than the dark air, a little lower, its arc flatter: a surface more than a space. Under the exposed passages, lower under an intro and an outro, absent in every full passage; events of eight bars laid end to end.

provenance.knowledge: authored: the research manual's listening hypotheses for this checkpoint (its §3, §5 and §6), written as rows so the weights are his to move; no record's arrangement copied
provenance.note: The manual's N1 on the vinyl bed's own row: a thinner, brighter surface.
